name: smwgraphics-castlevania-dracula-x-stages-4-and
title: Castlevania: Dracula X - Stages 4 and 4' (Caverns)
description:
A cave background seen through various portions of Stages 4 and 4', from Castlevania: Dracula X. Includes most color variants, along with a variant that has a stone pillar, which unfortunately, is a simplified rip, since the entire background would eat a lot of tiles. A good fit for caves or ruins.

The variants with no pillar use palette row 3, while the one with the pillar uses palette 0 and 5 as well.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
